title: Unreal Berries Blueberry & Lemon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blueberry & Lemon from Unreal Berries is a glorious blend of two perfectly paired fruit flavours. The deep, rich, juicy sweetness of fresh blueberries plays beautifully with the sharp, zesty tang of lemons, creating a fabulously fruity vape. Shortfill bottles from Unreal Berries E-liquids offer the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Unreal Berries are a range of 100ml shortfills that are made in the UK by Unreal e-liquids, a brand that are famous for their fruit flavours. They’ve paired only the very Berriest flavours in each blend for a deliciously natural tasting berry vape experience. Unreal shortfills come in 100ml shortfill bottles with space for one or two nicotine shots to let you tailor your e-liquid’s nicotine strength to your exact preference.
